instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Inside a warm creative workspace, two women sit at a wooden table in front of shelves filled with craft supplies. On the left, the woman in the yellow blazer (R2) sits angled right, looking at her companion while gesturing with her right hand. On the right, the woman in the black top (R1) sits angled left, looking at the woman in the yellow blazer (R2) and pointing at the open notebook with her right hand. The two sit side-by-side, collaborating closely over the notebook. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the natural wood tones.
elements: R1 points at the open notebook with her right hand while collaborating with R2
R2 gestures with her right hand while looking at R1
R1 and R2 sit side-by-side angled toward each other over the notebook
open notebook on the wooden table
warm creative workspace with shelves of craft supplies
